title: Sort by running time on GET /Items is unobserved; a running-time range filter is beyond what any supported app shows
notes: Issue #115. Evidence, by the lead: one differential request with SortBy=Runtime, both directions, against Jellyfin 12.4. A wrong order goes to JS-068 (jellyfin-web offers the sort). The range filter is not planned: no goal, and no supported app shows one. Closed at the pivot: Both auditors: tied to Jellyfin's API, its apps, jellyfin-web or its captures, which go at the cutover (D-107, mandate rule 3).
